LanguageData.RAV_Desc_ProAPI: Select a provider and enter your API Key for Pro generation.\nTip: Use Player2 for free generation, or register on SiliconFlow with invite code hazSLAR1 for free credits.\nCloud providers use OpenAI-compatible format; Local providers (ComfyUI/SD-WebUI) need no API Key.
LanguageData.RAV_Tip_Doc_SiliconFlow: SiliconFlow - Recommended for Chinese users. Supports Qwen/Flux models.\nDocs: siliconflow.cn/docs\nUse invite code hazSLAR1 for free credits
LanguageData.RAV_Tip_Doc_Pollinations: Pollinations - Register with GitHub for $1.5/week free credits\nDocs: pollinations.ai or enter.pollinations.ai\nWith a personal API Key, the Free button also uses the stable new endpoint (no cooldown + Img2Img)
LanguageData.RAV_Tip_Doc_OpenAI: OpenAI - DALL-E 3 image model. Requires overseas account.\nDocs: platform.openai.com/docs\nNote: DALL-E 3 supports Txt2Img only, no Img2Img
LanguageData.RAV_Tip_Doc_ZhipuAI: ZhipuAI - Chinese CogView-4 model.\nDocs: open.bigmodel.cn/dev/api\nTxt2Img only, no Img2Img support
LanguageData.RAV_Tip_Doc_TogetherAI: Together AI - FLUX.1-schnell and other open-source models.\nDocs: docs.together.ai\nPlease verify endpoint URL and model names in their docs
LanguageData.RAV_Tip_Doc_FireworksAI: Fireworks AI - FLUX series fast inference.\nDocs: fireworks.ai/docs\nPlease verify endpoint URL and model names in their docs
LanguageData.RAV_Tip_Doc_ComfyUI:
ComfyUI Local Generation - No API Key needed, completely free
Start ComfyUI first (default port 8188)
Enter checkpoint filename as model name (e.g. v1-5-pruned-emaonly.safetensors)
Supports Txt2Img and Img2Img
LanguageData.RAV_Tip_Doc_SDWebUI:
SD-WebUI Local Generation - No API Key needed, completely free
Start SD-WebUI with --api flag (default port 7860)
Enter checkpoint filename as model name (optional, leave empty to use current model)
Supports Txt2Img and Img2Img
